evidence.text: Vibration 6.10 mm/s vs 1.68 baseline (ISO 10816 alarm band 4.5 to 7.1)
Vibration rising 7 straight days, 2.71 to 6.10 mm/s
Temperature 74.6 C vs 59.4 C baseline (+15.2 C)
Bearing-type fault found on this asset in an earlier PM

alerts.reasoning: Steady 7-day rise in vibration with matching temperature rise is the classic signature of progressive bearing wear on the gearbox output shaft. Pattern is not a spike. At current slope, vibration reaches the unacceptable band (above 7.1 mm/s) in about 2 days.
alerts.recommended_action: Replace output shaft bearing (22312) and change gear oil during Sunday planned shutdown. Apply LOTO. Laser-check alignment after fitting.

evidence.text: OB-004 (Mohan Iyer, 30 yrs): burning smell near panel, contactor buzzing (recorded in Hinglish)
Feeder 3 breaker tripped once this morning
KL-06: buzzing contactor + burnt insulation smell = overheating contacts or loose lug

alerts.reasoning: Burning smell plus contactor chatter on a 1997 MCC matches the veteran knowledge entry for overheating contacts. MCC-3 feeds the whole of Line 3, so consequence is high.
alerts.recommended_action: Thermal scan and inspect feeder 3 contactor and lugs, replace contactor if pitted. HT-certified electrician only, full LOTO.

checks.detail: No Electrical HT technician on current shift A. Only P07-T02 (shift C) qualified.

evidence.text: Single reading 7.80 mm/s on 16 Oct, flagged as spike
Readings before and after within baseline (1.97 mm/s), flat 7-day trend

alerts.reasoning: One-off sample with no trend and no temperature change. Most likely a transient (robot collision stop or sensor knock). Pulling the line would cost production for no likely gain.
alerts.recommended_action: No intervention. Keep monitoring; re-alert if 2 consecutive readings exceed 4.5 mm/s.

evidence.text: OB-002 (Ramesh Patil, 32 yrs): oil puddle under main cylinder
Pressure build 8 to 10 s slower than normal
KL-03: slow ram + pump whine = internal or external leak

alerts.reasoning: Visible leak plus slower pressure build points to a failing cylinder seal. Press is criticality A but still producing; repair in the next changeover avoids an unplanned stop.
alerts.recommended_action: Replace main cylinder seal kit, inspect hoses, top up oil. LOTO and hydraulic pressure release required.

checks.detail: P07-T04 rejected: LOTO expired 30 Sep 2026. P07-T09 assigned (LOTO valid to 10 Nov 2026).

evidence.text: OB-001 (Gurpreet Singh, 26 yrs): knocking at startup that settles, burnt oil smell
KL-01: startup knock fading as oil warms = early big-end or main bearing wear

alerts.reasoning: Startup knock that fades is the veteran signature for bearing wear with marginal lubrication on reciprocating compressors.
alerts.recommended_action: Change compressor oil, inspect main bearing clearance, replace bearing if play found.

proposed_window.note: AC-2 covers air demand during repair

evidence.text: Motor temperature 71.9 C vs 51.7 C baseline (+20.2 C)
Steady rise over 9 days, vibration only slightly up (2.71 mm/s)

alerts.reasoning: Temperature rising without matching vibration suggests cooling or load issue rather than mechanical damage. Replacement servo motor is out of stock with 45-day lead time, so prevent failure first.
alerts.recommended_action: Clean motor fan and filter, check drive current and duty cycle settings. Raise urgent purchase order for spare servo motor.

checks.detail: Critical spare out of stock: procurement flagged

evidence.text: OB-005 (Kavya Reddy, trainee): 'running a bit funny', no specific symptom

alerts.reasoning: Note has no specific sound, smell, heat or location. Not enough to diagnose. Good learning moment: pair trainee with a veteran for a guided check.
alerts.recommended_action: Guided inspection by veteran with the trainee. Record specific symptoms using the capture checklist.

evidence.text: No vibration or temperature data since 14 Oct (4 days)

alerts.reasoning: Labeller condition cannot be confirmed while the sensor is offline. Keep its calendar PM until data returns.
alerts.recommended_action: Check sensor cable, connector and gateway. Keep scheduled PM until data restored.
